narrative.details: The rod, now complete, lies in your hands. Shael'dryn will want to hear of your success.
narrative.objectives: Return to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.
narrative.offerRewardText: You've done it, adventurer! Well done!

chain.subtitle: 11 quests from level 19 to 30, 17,385 XP in all.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Find the Glowing Gem and return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar with Teronis' Journal.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Find Shael'dryn at the moonwell to the northeast.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Find the Wooden Key and a piece of Dartol's Rod before returning to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Find the final piece of Dartol's Rod and return to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Find the hidden shrine and re-enchant Dartol's Rod.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Return to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Find an uncorrupted furbolg, and using the power of Dartol's Rod of Transformation, speak to him.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Kill 4 Bloodtooth Guards and retrieve Ran Bloodtooth's Skull for Krolg near Lake Mystral.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.objectiveText: Bring Ran Bloodtooth's Skull and Dartol's Rod of Transformation to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
